code: status = tinfl_decompress(&pState->m_decomp, pStream->next_in, &in_bytes, pState->m_dict, pState->m_dict + pState->m_dict_ofs, &out_bytes, decomp_flags);
note: Caller-controlled compressed bytes are passed into the decompressor.
The code records the decompressor's output count without ensuring any bytes were actually initialized before later copying from the dictionary.
When the decompressor produced no output bytes, this copy can read uninitialized dictionary contents and trigger MSan.
